faq.title: Straight answers
faq.q1: When do I get the money?
faq.a1: Commission accrues when the order reaches the buyer, and opens for withdrawal 14 days later. That window covers refunds and disputes — without it we would have to claw back money already paid out. It runs per order: after the first fortnight, money opens up continuously.
faq.a2: 50,000 so'm. We make every transfer by hand, so there is a floor. What you have earned does not expire — it sits on your balance until it adds up.
faq.q3: What if a buyer gets a refund?
faq.a3: If it happens inside the hold window, the commission on that order is cancelled. After it, the money is yours. Only that commission goes: the buyer stays attributed to you.
faq.q4: Does the code work for existing customers?
faq.a4: No. The code works on a person's first order only — it is for bringing new buyers, not a standing discount. After that they pay the normal price and you still get your 2%.
faq.q5: What do I earn on repeat orders?
faq.a5: The same as on the first. The buyer is yours for good, and you earn on every order they place — not only the one where they typed your code.
faq.q6: Do I need a big audience?
faq.a6: There is no minimum. What matters is how close your topic is to what we sell: game currency, Nitro, Telegram Premium, Roblox. An 800-subscriber Standoff 2 channel fits better than a 50,000-subscriber one about something else.
